landing.badge: AI QA agent for small teams
landing.title: Test your site before your customers do
landing.subtitle: Tell QAgent what to check. It uses your site like a real user and tells you exactly what broke, where, and why.
landing.step1Body: Paste your URL and write the goal in plain Persian or English — or pick a template.
landing.step2Body: QAgent plans scenarios and clicks through your site in a real browser while you watch live.
landing.step3Body: Bugs with severity, reproduction steps, screenshots, and console & network errors.
landing.demoCaption: Live run: the agent removes an item from the cart and catches a 500 error.
landing.freeFeatures: 10 runs per day|Live run viewer|Shareable reports
landing.proFeatures: 300 runs per month|Test accounts & login flows|Replay re-runs at $0 LLM cost
